title: Reuse the old target rather than relabel it unresolved
statement: For F_(beta,r)=T²+4beta*qX+4(r-1)q² and |beta|<=1, the accepted envelope is r>=U(|beta|), with U(b)=1/2+(302/99)b for b<=99/100 and U(b)=48b-44 above. It combines convex C=T²-2q², the already accepted ROOT25 vertex(beta,r)=(99/100,88/25), and the new seed endpoint. Source L4 moduli add under the declared interpolation; the initial chord does not assert a weighted |M|²|Dphi|² modulus. Negative beta uses orthogonal transport and extra determinant square is QC by Jensen/null-Lagrangian structure. The new contribution is the high-beta segment/endpoint, not a new resolution of the old target or the residual curved ROC region.
